Kishan highlighted Sooryavanshi's attacking style as a significant team asset.

title: Pradhan resigns: Govt took exit call after Wangchuk breakthrough failed to end protests

The government chose pragmatism over defiance when confronted by Gen Z's viral campaigns. Previously, the government withdrew farm laws and diffused protests against the Citizenship Amendment Act. The party now faces the challenge of winning over a restive generation concerned about employment.

title: Jeff Bezos ex-wife MacKenzie Scott helped write a 'donation playbook' for Snap founder
content: Snap co-founder Evan Spiegel and Miranda Kerr have donated $550 million to erase medical debt. This significant contribution will benefit over 261,000 Californians facing financial hardship. The donation follows a philanthropic model pioneered by MacKenzie Scott. Undue Medical Debt will administer the funds, targeting vulnerable residents statewide. This initiative aims to unburden families from unpayable medical expenses.

title: Lionel Messi seen for first time since painful World Cup final loss

The emotional captain spent time with family, supported his brother’s football club Leones FC, and avoided media attention. Messi will soon return to Inter Miami after recovering from the demanding tournament.

title: US govt updates list of H-1B debarred & disqualified companies; what it means
content: The US Department of Labor has updated its list of H-1B visa program violators. Four companies are now temporarily barred from filing H-1B petitions. GowraTech, LLC and Renotek Group LLC face debarment until 2027. Seeloz, Inc. and Sherwood Academy are barred until 2028. This action affects employers found to be willful violators of program rules.

title: Zebra mussels spread across all Great Lakes within a decade of arriving in 1988
content: Zebra mussels, an aquatic invader from Eurasia, continue their continental spread after arriving in North America.  These tiny shellfish are now infesting Lake Meredith in Texas, raising new concerns.  Officials confirmed a reproducing population, marking the lake as a potential stepping stone.  The mussels damage ecosystems and infrastructure by clinging to hard surfaces and multiplying rapidly.  Preventative measures like cleaning boats remain crucial to slowing their ongoing invasion.

title: Indian-origin man on green card says 'wouldn't move to US on H-1B today
content: Mohamed Zeeshan, an Indian-origin man who moved to the United States after being attracted to its 'values' has now said he 'wouldn't do it today' on an H-1B visa. Zeeshan, who now owns a consulting firm, said he is also seeing a rising trend of his relatives and friends looking at other options like Germany and Australia since it's become difficult to land a job and visa in the US after graduating.

title: Elon Musk's SpaceX in talks to sell Pentagon billions in AI data-centre capacity
content: SpaceX is discussing a multi-billion dollar deal with the US Defense Department. This agreement would provide data-center capacity for advanced artificial intelligence models. The Pentagon seeks to secure high-end compute power for its agencies and military units. SpaceX has recently signed similar cloud-compute deals with other major tech companies. This potential pact would significantly expand SpaceX's role in national security infrastructure.

title: Delhi metro fully operational a day after CJP withdraws protest

Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned from his post on Saturday. This action led to the CJP ending its demonstration at Jantar Mantar. Normal metro services resumed across the city after the disruptions concluded.

title: Patrick Mahomes says wife and kids gave meaning to his NFL greatness

From overcoming injuries to balancing life as a husband and father, he credits Brittany Mahomes and their children for keeping him grounded. His emotional words and never-give-up mindset show that resilience, patience and love have shaped both his life and his legendary NFL career.

title: Gabriel Langton remains conscious after horrific Commonwealth Games fall
content: Gabriel Langton suffered a horrific fall during the men's team gymnastics final at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow after missing a catch on the high bar. The England gymnast was treated on the arena floor before being taken to hospital in a neck brace. Team England later shared an encouraging update on his condition. Here's everything we know about how the accident happened, the latest injury update, his current condition, and what it could mean for his recovery and return to competition.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes turned family grief into a mission of hope
content: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes attended a back-to-school event with FARE just before Chiefs training camp, continuing their advocacy for food allergy awareness. The couple's mission comes from personal experience after their children, Sterling and Bronze, were diagnosed with food allergies. Brittany has previously shared the frightening details of Bronze's severe allergic reaction and how it inspired the family to help others. Here's how Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes are using their platform to support parents and create safer environments for children with food allergies.

title: Tariffs on trial: Small businesses take Trump's latest trade levies back to court
content: Two groups of small businesses are challenging Donald Trump's latest tariffs in court. These new levies target goods from sixty trading partners and cover nearly all US imports. Businesses argue the administration failed to justify these measures against individual economies. They contend the tariffs replace previous worldwide duties struck down by the Supreme Court. Legal experts believe these new tariffs will likely remain in place for an extended period.

title: 'Gens Una Sumus' - What three Latin words beneath a chess emblem taught me about the world
content: India's young Grandmaster Aarav Dengla has played chess against opponents of every age and from countries across the world. In his debut The Grandmaster View column, he reflects on the three Latin words beneath the FIDE emblem that first caught his attention as a seven-year-old. Through memories from tournament halls and the quiet rituals that follow every game, Aarav explores how Gens Una Sumus - "We are one family" - is more than just the sport's motto; it is the enduring spirit of chess itself.

title: Talks on with US for concessional access for textile goods, says govt

Many key Indian exports, like pharmaceuticals, remain outside these additional duties.  The government is working on a textile-specific exemption as part of trade talks.  This engagement aims to secure better access for Indian products in the US market.

title: Kargil Vijay Diwas: How India took the high ground from Pak, rewrote military doctrine
content: Kargil Vijay Diwas marks India's 1999 victory and honors fallen soldiers.  The conflict reshaped India's defence preparedness and strategic outlook significantly.  Reforms included creating the Chief of Defence Staff and increasing defence spending.  India's defence production and exports have grown substantially over recent years.  The legacy of Kargil continues to inspire courage and national resolve today.

title: Sarnath joins Unesco World Heritage list
content: the ancient Buddhist site of Sarnath in Uttar Pradesh was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List . it became the 45th site to receive this recognition . india ranks sixth globally and second in Asia Pacific Region for the most number of ‘World Heritage Sites’ .

title: Left scores win, despite its shrunken presence, through its student organs
content: left parties successfully leveraged AISA, SFI and AISF to pressure govt to give into demand of getting Dharmendra Pradhan to resign as education minister . despite having no prior association with Abhijeet Dipke, they sat on a 23-day hunger strike in solidarity with the students . the victory of their student outfits could act as a compensation of sorts for the Left in an electorally bleak season .

title: From one paper leak protest to another: Full circle for Dharmendra Pradhan
content: architect of BJP's maiden victory in Odisha was catapulted into limelight . he led an ABVP-backed agitation against an alleged class XII question paper leak . four years later, he won the assembly seat on a BJP ticket .
